The '''Kt'Aya clan''' was a [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]] clan. [[Zal Afreg Kt'Aya]] was a member of the clan. The head of the clan favored a neutral stance in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
